_comment: FR5a envelope-shape gates: TS is the reference port for source.format / source.files / source.jsonPath. C# is now reconciled with TS on the JSON-side FR5a envelopes (parser malformed-JSON catch builds a $-rooted JsonSource with the source-file name; inline-attr loop reports ERR_RESERVED_ATTR / ERR_UNKNOWN_ATTR / ERR_BAD_ATTR_VALUE at the parent's path — not key-deeper). Keep this file as the documented ledger surface.
_notes: FR5c (finalized 2026-05-27, all four ports): merge-phase contributors + ERR_MERGE_CONFLICT envelope + WARN_DUPLICATE_DECLARATION. FR5d (finalized 2026-05-27, all four ports): reference-resolution errors emit format=resolved with referrer + target. FR-013 (@readOnly), FR-014 (TPH discriminator), and FR-015 (@parameterRef) VALIDATION passes shipped in the C# port (ValidationPasses.ValidateFieldReadOnly / ValidateDiscriminator / ValidateSourceParameterRef); all error-* fixtures now produce the expected envelopes. No interim known-gaps.
_comment_ai_pilot: AI LLM-call trace fixtures ai-trace-prompt-nested and ai-trace-sti now load + canonical-serialize cleanly in the C# port (Unit 1 metamodel slice): @responseRef is registered on template.prompt (carved out of the cross-port registry manifest as ExclusionReason.TsPilotVocab until the atomic all-ports flip), and template.* is admitted as an object.entity child (CoreTypes objectRules). The sibling ai-llm-call-extends has always passed cross-port.
_comment_fr024: FR-024 Phase B — dotted Entity.child extends-resolution shipped in the TS reference port only; un-ledger in Phase E (cross-port fan-out). error-extends-entity-field-unresolved is NOT ledgered: a dotted ref is simply unresolvable here, so this port already emits the identical ERR_UNRESOLVED_SUPER envelope and the fixture passes.
_comment_fr024_b3: FR-024 B3 — identity names required + projection identity pass-through shipped in the TS reference port only; un-ledger in Phase E. projection-basic / projection-identity-fields-explicit use the object.projection subtype this port does not register yet; error-identity-name-required expects an error this port does not emit yet; error-projection-identity-not-extended / error-identity-key-mismatch expect FR-024 pass-through codes on object.projection inputs this port cannot load.
_comment_fr024_b4a: FR-024 B4a — value-purity + projection-licensing subtype rules shipped in the TS reference port only; un-ledger in Phase E. projection-extends-projection / error-projection-extends-entity / error-projection-source-writable use the object.projection subtype this port does not register yet, so it cannot load them. error-value-with-identity-secondary / error-value-with-source are plain object.value inputs this port CAN load — but it enforces only the legacy value-with-PRIMARY-identity rule today, not the full FR-024 value-purity rule (a value object carries no identity of ANY subtype and no source.*), so a secondary identity or a source.rdb on a value loads cleanly here while the fixture expects ERR_SUBTYPE_RULE_VIOLATION.
_comment_fr024_b5: FR-024 B5 — @via single-hop-unique inference + origin cardinality checks shipped in the TS reference port only; un-ledger in Phase E. origin-via-inferred-single-hop uses the object.projection subtype this port does not register yet (and an entity-hosted no-@via passthrough this port cannot infer); error-origin-via-ambiguous expects ERR_AMBIGUOUS_PATH this port does not emit yet; error-origin-passthrough-to-many / error-origin-aggregate-no-to-many expect ERR_ORIGIN_CARDINALITY on object.projection inputs this port cannot load. Phase-E note: the TS registry flipped origin.aggregate @via to OPTIONAL (inferable, ADR-0029); the cross-port manifest still records required:true via the TS FR024_PENDING_REQUIRED_OVERRIDES carve-out — flip this port's OriginSchema aggregate @via AttrSchema to Required=false at fan-out.
_comment_fr024_b6: FR-024 B6 — extends/origin agreement + derived-field providability shipped in the TS reference port only; un-ledger in Phase E. error-extends-origin-mismatch uses the object.projection subtype this port does not register yet AND expects ERR_EXTENDS_ORIGIN_MISMATCH this port does not emit; error-derived-field-no-read-source is a pure-entity input this port loads cleanly (no providability pass yet), so it emits zero errors where the fixture expects ERR_DERIVED_FIELD_NO_READ_SOURCE; entity-derived-fields-multi-source is the spec §7 worked example whose countryName field uses the dotted Entity.child extends form (extends: "Country.name") this port cannot resolve yet, so it fails with ERR_UNRESOLVED_SUPER instead of loading. Phase-E note: until the B4b cutover removes view-PRIMARY entities, the providability rule counts a read-only-kind PRIMARY source as providable (legacy spelling) — port that accommodation with the pass.
